All the Reasons to Join Us

A rich world of exciting opportunities, throughout your career.

At TSG, we drive innovation in the fields of intelligence, cyber, and data-rich products with cutting-edge solutions. Our offerings are transforming the business landscape, municipal sector, and defense strategies in Israel and worldwide every day.

As strategic partners, we support and inspire companies, organizations, municipalities, and defense industries around the world. Our secret? A blend of technological excellence and human capital, providing precise solutions to every challenge.

We invite you to get to know us and enjoy a dynamic, innovative work environment. We offer work-life balance, diversity and inclusion, along with professional horizons and advancement opportunities.

Be part of fascinating projects and take on meaningful work, covering a wide spectrum of technological, business, and managerial content. You will be helping to create real change and impact people's daily lives.

We currently have no job openings

Looking for a meaningful career? An inspiring work environment?

Join a technological incubator for creative people who think outside the box and seek to shape the future. Discover all the reasons that make us a warm home for excellence, diversity, growth, and development:

  • Culture of Diversity and InclusionWe live in a diverse world with countless opinions and cultures. Each person represents a unique perspective that contributes to the whole. Thus, enriching themselves and their environment.

  • A Place of Unlimited PossibilitiesAt TSG, we believe diverse and multi-skilled teams are the basis for productivity and success in any project. We work towards fairness, diverse employment, equal opportunities for all, and inclusion, regardless of religion, race, sexual orientation, and gender.

  • A New World of Content You Have Yet to ExperienceChallenge and interest in fascinating and innovative fields are an integral part of our daily work. Advanced command and control systems, and innovative tools developed for intelligence agencies, give you just a small glimpse into our capabilities.

  • An Enriching and Quality Work EnvironmentWe're pleased to offer you a dynamic and fascinating work environment, providing you with a solid foundation, stability, and job security. In our community, employees enjoy an environment combining family-like support, professional interest, and rewards.

  • Join the Best, Influence and ChangeWith us, you can integrate into a variety of fascinating and meaningful roles. You can create and solidify significant change processes that affect all our daily lives – in defense, communication, intelligence, and the municipal world.

  • Knowledge is Power – Professional and Personal DevelopmentWe believe in continuous learning as the key to personal and professional development and excellence. Our learning and enrichment system includes technological courses, workshops, training, professional conferences, and more.

  • Welfare and Personal EmpowermentWe encourage a pleasant and empowering organizational culture that includes free expression. We accompany you in the exciting and joyful moments of your life and the lives of those dear to you. We like to spice up the routine and diversify life with a selection of cultural, sports, and leisure activities.

  • Accompanying You to Your Next DestinationYour success is our success. That's why we care about and promote your career progress.

    At TSG, we enable advancement and development in a variety of fields, roles, and projects, so you can always grow with us.

Not sure which position suits you best?

Submit your resume, and we’ll reach out if we find a match. If your skills align with our needs, we’ll be in touch soon. Thank you for your interest in joining our team.
